posts.title: 11oct2006 Bay Area Sandwiches
posts.description: If you follow me on social media you may have noticed me posting photos of sandwiches. A lot of sandwiches. I've been doing this for a long time but for the past year or so, the number has increased. This is because I've been working on a project: a combination map and blog of Bay Area sandwiches. posts.title: 03Oct2026 another https outage
posts.description: Back in April I had to turn off https service for a month due to getting hammered by LLM scraper bots. I eventually found a software fix that lowered the impact by a lot, so I could turn https back on. posts.title: 02Sep2026 lmin 1.00 released
posts.description: First release of my new small LISP interpreter lmin . It is intended to be embeddable as an extension language in other projects. Someday it may become the extension language for emin .
